selection: second round after a failed label (picked)

neighbours.label: the piece right after 'non' when it is a word for the usual kind or category (non|traditional, non|standard, non|farm, non|resident, non|essential, non|professional), as opposed to the same word without 'non'
fire: Older nontraditional students take evening classes here.
The file uses a nonstandard date format.
Nonfarm jobs rose by a small amount in May.
Nonresident fees are twice the local price.
All nonessential staff were sent home early.
These nonprofessional players train on weekends.
Most nonacademic workers got a raise.
quiet: Older traditional students take evening classes here.
The file uses a standard date format.
Farm jobs rose by a small amount in May.
Resident fees are half the visitor price.
All essential staff were kept at work late.
These professional players train on weekends.
Most academic workers got a raise.

notes: Second round. In a sweep, 'word after non- / non' failed on median (0.177): 'traditional', 'standard', 'farm' 0.59–0.79 and 'verbal', 'violent', 'fiction' at or below 0.10. Tokenization checked; hyphenated forms are left out.
